title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 10: the names of those who sealed the covenant and the promises the people made about God's law and his house.

questions.text: Whose name stands first in the list of those who sealed the covenant?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:1 names Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, first among those who sealed.

answers.text: Ezra the scribe
Jeshua the son of Azaniah
Nehemiah the governor
Parosh, a chief of the people

questions.text: How does verse 8 describe the men listed just before it?
questions.explanation: After the list of names, verse 8 says: "These were the priests."

answers.text: The priests
The singers
The gatekeepers
The chiefs of the people

questions.text: The first Levite in the list is Jeshua. Whose son is he called?
questions.explanation: The Levites begin with Jeshua the son of Azaniah.

answers.text: Nun
Shealtiel
Zaccur
Azaniah

questions.text: What did the people promise about their daughters?
questions.explanation: They promised not to give their daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for their sons.

answers.text: To marry them only to priests
Not to give them to the peoples of the land
To keep them unmarried until age twenty
To give them to men of any tribe

questions.text: What did they promise to do if the peoples of the land brought grain to sell on the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: They promised that they would not buy from them on the Sabbath or on a holy day.

answers.text: Buy it only for the temple
Pay a double price for it
Not buy from them on the Sabbath
Send them away with a warning

questions.text: In the same verse about the Sabbath, what else did they promise to forego?
questions.explanation: They promised to forego the seventh year and the exaction of every debt.

answers.text: The new moon feasts and all fasting
The wood offering and the first fruits
The tax paid to the king
The seventh year and the exaction of every debt

questions.text: How much did they charge themselves yearly for the service of the house of God?
questions.explanation: They made an ordinance to charge themselves yearly with the third part of a shekel.

answers.text: The third part of a shekel
The half part of a shekel
A whole shekel of silver
The tenth part of a shekel

questions.text: What did the priests, Levites and people cast lots for?
questions.explanation: They cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it to the house of God at appointed times, year by year.

answers.text: The order of the singers
The wood offering
The land of their fathers
The high priest's garments

questions.text: What were the Levites to bring up to the treasure house of God's house?
questions.explanation: The Levites were to bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

answers.text: The firstborn of their flocks
All the grain of their fields
The silver of the temple tax
The tithe of the tithes

questions.text: With what promise does the chapter end?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends with the promise: "We will not forsake the house of our God."

answers.text: "We will not forsake the house of our God."
"We will not leave the city of Jerusalem."
"We will rebuild the wall again."
"We will not serve a foreign king."
